first_impression.summary_in_own_words: Someone called Wedded Concierge will help us get married in Portugal, in a palace in Sintra or on a cliff in the Algarve, and gives one advisor the whole way. The first thing it tells me is the legal stuff and that lots of people just do a symbolic ceremony there and the legal bit at home. No idea yet what it costs.

attention_map.quote: Get Married in Portugal, from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff
attention_map.why: A palace is something different to the usual Bali villa or Italian lake. That stops my thumb. The line about one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend is what I want to hear about not juggling suppliers in different time zones.

attention_map.quote: a legal wedding in Portugal for foreign couples starts at least one month ahead
attention_map.why: Fine, but I have not even decided on Portugal yet. Paperwork is not my first question at 10pm, cost is.

My guest number is in the list, so I feel like it could fit. But the button says 'Check your date' and then 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms dates and venues with you', so it is really just the start of a form.

attention_map.quote: Planned by Wedded Concierge, with one Wedded Advisor from enquiry to the wedding weekend.
attention_map.why: Third time I have read the same sentence. No numbers, no reviews, nothing that tells me they have actually done a wedding in Portugal.

attention_map.quote: Romantic palaces in the Sintra hills that can be booked for a wedding
attention_map.why: This is the bit I would screenshot and send to my partner. Real named places, not 'stunning venues'. The Monserrate scaffolding note is honest, I like that.
Five times in a row. Every region card dodges the one number I need. If you can't tell me whether 70 people fit in the Algarve, I can't tell if this is for us.

attention_map.quote: state events can cancel bookings at Queluz or the National Palace of Sintra
attention_map.why: So my wedding could get cancelled by the government? That is scary for something I am flying 70 people across the world for. It does not say what happens if it does.

attention_map.quote: Australian, US and UK passport holders can visit visa-free for up to 90 days
attention_map.why: Good that Australia is mentioned first, but most of this repeats what I already read above.

attention_map.quote: exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill
attention_map.why: This is exactly how a price blows out and it is nice someone is watching for it. But it makes me more nervous that I have no price to start from.

attention_map.quote: An overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised.
attention_map.why: Actually useful and specific to us. I have wondered about that.

attention_map.quote: What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things: your guest count, the region, the season, how many nights you take the venue and whether you book it for exclusive use.
attention_map.why: I opened the Costs tab hoping for a number and got 'it depends'. That is the answer every planner gives right before the quote doubles.

attention_map.quote: Many Lisbon-area venues are 15 to 30 minutes from the city centre, as a guide
attention_map.why: Nice, but nothing about how our guests get from Sydney or Perth to Lisbon, how long it takes or roughly what flights cost.

attention_map.quote: There is no set Portugal package.
attention_map.why: I came from Instagram thinking there were packages. The list of what a weekend 'can include' sounds lovely but it is not a package and not a price.

attention_map.quote: Many quintas have rooms, so your closest guests can stay where you marry, with nearby hotels for everyone else.
attention_map.why: Closest guests, but what about the other 50? No hotel ideas, no idea of cost per night.

attention_map.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is your one contact at Wedded Concierge, instead of one conversation per venue.
attention_map.why: The three steps are clear and I like having one contact. But I still don't know who this person is, where they are, or what hours they work for someone in Australia. No name, no face.

attention_map.quote: Anything we should know? Placeholder: Budget, dates you have in mind, anything else
attention_map.why: Not too bad on a phone since most fields are tap options. But I'm asked to give my budget and they still haven't given me theirs.

attention_map.quote: There is no single average: the cost depends on your guest count, the region, the season, the nights you take the venue and whether you book it for exclusive use.
attention_map.why: The FAQ cost answer is the same non-answer, word for word. Most of the rest is legal and I've already read it twice.

attention_map.quote: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's wedding
attention_map.why: Celebrity gossip links at the bottom make it feel like a magazine, not a planner I would hand $50k to.

questions_answered.question: What does this cost all in, and what is included in the from price?
questions_answered.evidence: No from price anywhere. Costs tab and FAQ 4 both say it 'depends on' guest count, region, season, nights and exclusive use. 'There is no set Portugal package.' The sticky bar has no price either.

questions_answered.question: Can it fit our guest count?
questions_answered.evidence: Every region card says 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor'. No named spaces with capacities, not even for the Sintra palaces. The guest-band picker only collects my number; it does not tell me what fits.

questions_answered.question: Who would actually plan this with us, and what do they do?
questions_answered.evidence: 'one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend', the three How It Works steps and the contract checks tell me what they do. No name, photo, location or time-zone hours, so I don't know who.

questions_answered.question: How do our guests get there and where do they stay?
questions_answered.evidence: Airports per region (LIS, OPO, FAO, FNC), Australian entry rules, and 'Many quintas have rooms ... with nearby hotels for everyone else'. Nothing on flights from Australia, travel time, or where the rest of the guests sleep.

questions_answered.question: Is our budget realistic for this place?
questions_answered.evidence: No figure of any kind, in AUD or euros. I can't tell if $40k for 60 people is laughable or comfortable.

objections_triggered.objection: I don't know if my budget is possible for this many people
objections_triggered.triggered_by: Costs tab and FAQ 4 fallback: 'depends on five things' with no figure; 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor' on all five region cards

objections_triggered.objection: Prices look like they start low and will blow out
objections_triggered.triggered_by: No price at all, plus the venue charges box: 'exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill', 'a buy-out is often charged separately', 'with a minimum'

objections_triggered.objection: Planning from overseas, time zones and suppliers I can't meet
objections_triggered.triggered_by: One Wedded Advisor helps, but no word on where they are based or how they handle time zones; no real weddings to show they have done this in Portugal

objections_triggered.objection: Every planner's page looks the same
objections_triggered.triggered_by: The palace and Douro spotlight feels different, but the repeated brand sentence and 'Ask your Wedded Advisor' everywhere feel like a template

trust_signals_noticed: Named places: Pena, Monserrate, Queluz, the Douro, with honest notes like Monserrate's roof works to early 2027
Australian passport section with Smartraveller and the Australian Embassy in Lisbon linked, 'Checked October 2026'
One Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend, with three clear steps
Venue contract checks: rooms, buy-outs, minimums, VAT
turn_offs_noticed: No price signal at all: no from price, no range, no AUD figure anywhere on the page
No real weddings at this destination
No capacities for any venue or region
The same brand sentence repeated three times near the top
Celebrity gossip links in the 'Read more' row
Long page with the legal process repeated in the hero, the reasons, the tab and two FAQs

emotional_response.excited_by: The idea of a Sintra palace or a Douro quinta. It feels different and romantic, not a standard package.
emotional_response.anxious_about: Money. Nothing tells me if we can afford it, and the state-event cancellation line worries me.
emotional_response.overall: Intrigued but not reassured. It feels like a well-researched travel guide with an enquiry form, not a planner showing me what I would get.

payload.decision_reason: The palace and Douro ideas are worth sending to my partner, and the Australian legal section is genuinely helpful, so I'd save it rather than close the tab. But I won't enquire: there's no price, no fit for our guest count and no named person, which is all three things I need. My guess is that at the weekend we look at somewhere that shows a price first.
payload.verbatim_reaction: Okay, a palace in Sintra, that's actually cool, screenshotting that. But how much? I tapped the Costs tab and it just says it depends. Every region says 'ask your advisor' for guests. Who even is the advisor? And they want my budget in the form when they won't give me a single number. Saving it to send to you, but honestly I think Italy pages at least give you a starting price.
